# Cardano canonical payload fixtures

The `.cbor` and `.key` files in this directory are generated by
[`generate.hs`](generate.hs). The generator mirrors the canonical encoders and
namespace key definitions from:

- `cardano-cls`
  `a7ddf62e6291b297889e78b4df95e2fb605c312f`
- `cardano-ledger`
  `fb8d6f8a83b0efb86281e0b80e7ffba160dad8b1`

The checked-in files were generated with GHC 9.10.3 from Docker image
`haskell:9.10.3`, digest
`sha256:7faaab177c19ab5b4258686b8a1c23f955aef8b7eb2e68e11a123a44f40e1df8`.

Regenerate the payload and key fixtures from the repository root:

```shell
docker run --rm -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
  -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work \
  haskell@sha256:7faaab177c19ab5b4258686b8a1c23f955aef8b7eb2e68e11a123a44f40e1df8 \
  runghc testdata/cardano/generate.hs
```

`canonical-namespaces.scls` contains one Haskell-generated canonical payload
for every registered namespace. It is assembled with the Go container writer:

```shell
go run ./testdata/cardano/generate_scls.go
```

The negative fixtures cover short and long keys, 95/97-byte BLS public-key
errors, 47/49-byte proof-of-possession errors, map field order, duplicate map
fields, and non-minimal CBOR.

`generate.hs` also writes typed fixtures that exercise populated values
(`*_populated`, `*_members`, `*_delegated`, `utxo_v0_*`, `gov_proposals_v0_*`
with one file per governance action variant, and ledger-ordered `utxo` and
proposal payloads) and `invalid_*.cbor` files that are deterministic CBOR but
violate their namespace schema. The generator is a hand-written mirror of the
encoders, so these files are not output of `cardano-cls` itself.
